zh.title: 立榮航空11月起實施國內線單獨旅行兒童服務費 每航段200元
zh.summary: 立榮航空11月1日起實施國內線單獨旅行兒童照護費每航段收取200元
body: 立榮航空公布，國內線自2026年11月1日起將實施「單獨旅行兒童」安心照護服務收費方案，每位旅客每航段收取服務費新台幣200元。該服務適用於5歲以上至未滿12歲無成年旅客陪同搭機的兒童，為必須辦理項目；12歲以上至未滿18歲的旅客，若有需求亦可提出申請。
根據立榮航空規定，旅客須透過客服中心辦理申請並完成付費，服務範圍涵蓋報到、安檢、登機引導及抵達後的交接作業。此外，中華航空與長榮航空目前針對單獨旅行兒童均採用成人票價，其中華航規定須於起飛前72小時提出申請，長榮則要求填寫單獨旅行兒童資料表。

en.title: UNI Air to Charge NT$200 Fee for Unaccompanied Minors on Domestic Routes from Nov 1
en.summary: UNI Air will introduce a NT$200 per-sector fee for unaccompanied minors on domestic flights from November 1.
body: UNI Air announced that starting November 1, 2026, it will implement an unaccompanied minor service fee scheme for domestic routes, charging NT$200 per passenger per flight segment. The service is mandatory for children aged 5 to under 12 traveling without an accompanying adult. Passengers aged 12 to under 18 may also apply for the service upon request.

The airline stated that applications and payments must be completed through its customer service center. The service covers check-in, security screening, boarding guidance, and arrival handover. Meanwhile, China Airlines and EVA Air both charge adult fares for unaccompanied minors, with China Airlines requiring applications at least 72 hours before departure and EVA Air requiring dedicated documentation.

zh.title: 零組件需求激增 逾十架波音737 MAX與A320neo今年面臨拆解
zh.summary: 航機零組件需求高漲；今年逾十架波音737 MAX與A320neo將進行拆解
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，隨著航空產業對拆解零組件的需求持續激增，今年預計將有超過 10 架波音 737 MAX 與空中巴士 A320neo 客機安排進行拆解作業。
在最新拆解計畫公布前數個月， Spirit Airlines 旗下已有 3 架空中巴士 A320neo 客機在僅僅投入實際營運服務約 3 年後即遭報廢拆解。這類服役年限尚短的新世代客機進入拆解流程，顯現出市場對於相關機種零組件的需求極為強勁。

en.title: Soaring Parts Demand Drives Teardown of Over 10 Boeing 737 MAX and A320neo Jets
en.summary: Strong parts demand drives planned teardowns of over ten 737 MAX and A320neo aircraft this year.
body: According to reporting from Simple Flying, more than ten Boeing 737 MAX and Airbus A320neo commercial jets are set for teardown this year as demand for spare aircraft parts continues to rise significantly.

The developments follow the recent scrapping of three Spirit Airlines Airbus A320neo aircraft. Those three jets were withdrawn from service and broken down after completing only three years of active operational service with the airline.

The scheduled dismantling of modern narrowbody models reflects an accelerating industry demand for aircraft components, as strong parts demand continues to drive early fleet retirement decisions across the commercial sector.

zh.title: 捷藍航空遭指要求轉簽旅客將備用衝浪板留在機場
zh.summary: 一名衝浪手表示因機票轉簽問題，遭捷藍航空要求將備用衝浪板留在機場。
body: 根據 Simple Flying 報導，一名知名衝浪手表示，在遭遇航班預訂更換調整後，他曾向現場工作人員請求，但最終仍被要求將一塊備用衝浪板留在機場。該事件涉及原本預訂聯合航空（United）航班的旅客，在轉乘捷藍航空（JetBlue）航班過程中發生的隨身與託運配備處理爭議。
報導指出，該名衝浪手稱其備用裝備因預訂更換無法隨機託運，儘管其向工作人員尋求協助，仍被迫將裝備置於機場。目前相關報導並未揭露事件具體日期或詳細航班資訊，涉事航空公司亦尚未對此個案發表官方回應。

en.title: JetBlue Allegedly Forces Passenger To Leave Surfboard Behind After Rebooking
en.summary: A surfer claims JetBlue agents forced him to leave a surfboard behind following a reservation swap.
body: According to a news report by Simple Flying, a well-known surfer stated that he pleaded with airline agents after an itinerary reservation swap forced him to leave a backup surfboard behind at the airport. The passenger had originally booked his travel on United before being transferred to a flight operated by JetBlue.

The report indicated that airline agents allegedly refused to accommodate the extra surf equipment following the itinerary change. No official statements or additional operational details regarding the specific airport location, flight schedule, or carrier policies were included in the summary report.

zh.title: Joby自駕Cessna Caravan展開美國巡迴展示
zh.summary: Joby自駕Cessna Caravan；展開美國跨州巡迴
body: 航太公司Joby Aviation宣布，其自主飛行系統改裝的Cessna Grand Caravan機型J208已開始為期一個月的美國巡迴展示，從加州前往東岸再折返，沿途停留10個州。
此巡迴是Joby 2026年『Electric Skies』計畫的一部分，旨在展示其自主飛行系統在民用與國防作業的潛在應用。
根據公司說法，J208已執行超過400次飛行，累計逾800小時的自動飛行時數；其自動化系統源自2024年收購的Xwing公司。

en.title: Joby's autonomous Cessna Caravan begins cross-country US tour
en.summary: Joby's autonomous Cessna Caravan begins month-long US tour across 10 states.
body: Joby Aviation has begun a month-long tour across the US to demonstrate the capabilities of its autonomous aircraft, travelling from California to the East Coast and back through a series of stops in 10 states.

The tour, part of Joby's 2026 'Electric Skies' programme, is designed to showcase the real-world operational maturity of the company's autonomous flight system and its potential applications in both civilian and defence operations.

The J208, a converted Cessna Grand Caravan equipped with the company's autonomous flight technology, has completed more than 400 flights and accumulated more than 800 hours of automated flight time. Its autonomy system originated with Xwing, a company acquired by Joby in 2024.

zh.title: 911事件25週年：航空安檢演變歷程回顧
zh.summary: 911事件25週年；航空安檢從強化機門到全身掃描儀演變；TSA成立
body: 航空全球新聞於9月11日發布報導，回顧911事件25年來對航空安檢的深遠影響。報導指出，強化駕駛艙門、托運行李炸藥檢查及乘客進場前的廣泛審查，皆源於襲擊後的安全變革。
美國在2001年11月19日通過航空與運輸安全法案，成立運輸安全管理局（TSA），將旅客安檢納入聯邦管轄。2002年底前，TSA在全美部署炸藥偵測系統，實現托運行李全檢。
2010年起，TSA開始在機場裝設全身掃描儀，以偵測非金屬威脅。報導同時提到，新製造的美國客機將加裝第二道物理屏障保護駕駛艙，顯示安檢措施持續演進。

en.title: 25 Years After 9/11: How Aviation Security Has Evolved Since the Attacks
en.summary: 25th anniversary of 9/11; aviation security evolution from reinforced cockpit doors to full-body scanners; TSA creation
body: Aerospace Global News published a retrospective on 11 September marking 25 years since the 9/11 attacks. The article notes that reinforced cockpit doors, explosives screening of checked baggage, and extensive pre‑airport passenger checks all originated from the post‑attack security overhaul.

The US Aviation and Transportation Security Act became law on 19 November 2001, creating the Transportation Security Administration (TSA) and federalising passenger screening. By December 2002 the TSA had deployed explosives detection systems nationwide, achieving 100% hold‑bag screening.

Full‑body scanners began appearing at US airports in 2010 to detect non‑metallic threats. The report also highlights that newly built US airliners will receive a second physical barrier protecting the flight deck, showing that security measures continue to evolve.
